Name: Tree Changes
Author: JPANv2
Description:
A simple mod that does simple things. It allows the user, through a config file, to change the chances of wood tree growth, spread and having an item when shaken, as well as allowing the user to define their own items to fall off trees, including JsonAssets defined objects.

The mod is open source, and anyone is invited to use it as they see fit, or updating it if I'm not able. Github [url=https://github.com/JPANv2/Stardew-Valley-Tree-Changes]here[/url]. Instructions on the config file structure are present in the github wiki.

Downloads.Description: Update adding new ways to manipulate spawned stones and items, with Skill, time and Weather based changes.
